onoda: This soldier kept fighting World War Two... for twenty-nine years after it ended.
In nineteen forty-four, Japan sent Lieutenant Hiroo Onoda to a jungle island in the Philippines.
His orders? Hold out. And never surrender.
Then, leaflets fell from the sky. The war is over. Come out.
He was sure it was an enemy trick.
So he stayed. Patching his uniform, cleaning his rifle, raiding farms for food...
for a war that no longer existed. His raids even cost lives on the island.
Then, in nineteen seventy-four, a young traveller came looking for three things.
Lieutenant Onoda, a panda, and the Abominable Snowman. In that order.
He found Onoda in four days. But Onoda still refused to quit.
He'd only stop on an order from his commanding officer.
So they found his old major, now a bookseller, and flew him to the island.
And on March ninth, he read the order out loud.
After twenty-nine years... Onoda finally lowered his rifle.
